note: The order the benchmark is climbed (plan 2026-10-04). Stage 'screen' is run once for every profile: the pilot task, then the other six screen tasks, one run each. Stage 'full' is run only for the top 3 chosen from `acceptance screen`: the remaining core tasks, then the scaled depth task. A rung is done for a profile when every task has its runs recorded without an infrastructure or capacity failure. `tiebreak` names the extra tasks to run for boundary candidates when the third place is a near-tie.

rungs.adds: opencode in the sandbox, relay, export, grader, metrics, restore: the attended live pilot, credited to the screen
after: Open report_html and check the workload scorecard renders with real numbers; only then ask the owner for the cross-run report layout and design it from the real rows.

Audit wide capture in the run folder: telemetry/host.jsonl for partial_errors, raw/server/*.json for error or non-200, workload/<trial>/raw/capture-errors.json; tell the owner which sources are empty or noise.

rungs.adds: the rest of the screen: resume, advisory, ops, surgery, review, implementation
the scaled depth task: the session is grown to 90% of this mode's compaction point, then asked about an early instruction (top 3 only)
